subject: Pilot accelerator: surge-capacity offer and short-term runway options
messages:
From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@sparrow.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.bell@sparrow.ai, procurement@sparrow.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot planning — surge needs next week

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads up — engineering ran a load test last night and the feature branch will need an extra 48–72 hours of dedicated inference throughput to validate latency under production-like traffic. Our pilot hits an upper bound we didn’t anticipate.

Can Redwood provide an add-on for a short burst (surge) of capacity next week? We’re trying to avoid extending the pilot by an extra full month if possible. Ideally we’d buy a one-week accelerator that gives us guaranteed concurrency and a small discount if we convert to a quarterly committed plan within 30 days.

What options/pricing do you have for a short, time-boxed runway boost + fast-convert incentive? Also please attach a one-page proposal we can share with procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lane
Lead PM — SparrowAI

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@sparrow.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot planning — surge needs next week

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and for surfacing the load test results. Short answer: yes. We have three practical paths that customers use for this exact situation; I’ve summarized them below and attached a short proposal PDF for procurement: PoC_Accelerator_Proposal_v1.pdf.

Options (short summary):
1) Surge Booster (time-boxed): 1-week burst of reserved concurrency (N GPUs) with per-minute metering. No long-term commitment. Description: ideal for validation stress tests. Price: $X/day (see attached).

2) Credit Top-up + Conversion Credit: Buy a block of credits valid for 30 days to cover the surge. If you sign a 3-month reserved commitment within 30 days, we apply a conversion credit equal to 20% of the top-up spend against the first month.

3) Short Runway + Accelerated Commit: Extend pilot by 2 weeks on an accelerated convert discount — we’ll give a one-time 10% conversion rebate if you convert to a quarter commit within 14 days after the runway.

Recommended: Option 1 (Surge Booster) for the immediate test (fastest to provision) plus Option 2 if SparrowAI wants a visible conversion incentive for procurement.

Next steps I suggest:
- I’ll provision a sample Surge Booster quote for the week starting Mon 3/15 and share an SOW draft the same day.
- Procurement can review PoC_Accelerator_Proposal_v1.pdf (attached).
- If acceptable, we’ll send a short addendum to the existing pilot SOW (Sparrow_SOW_draft.docx) and a DocuSign link for signatures.

Would you like me to lock in a provisional date now? I can hold capacity for 24 hours.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Bell <tom.bell@sparrow.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@sparrow.ai>, procurement@sparrow.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot planning — surge needs next week

Vanessa — appreciate the quick options. Procurement’s ask: keep legal churn low. They prefer either (A) a short, standalone addendum (one paragraph) that preserves current pilot terms but adds the surge capacity and billing; or (B) a credit top-up invoice we can pay now with a clear conversion credit outlined.

Two clarifications we need:
- Is the Surge Booster billed as a flat daily fee or usage metered per-token?
- How quickly can we get guaranteed concurrency for the week (provisioning SLAs)?

If you can put the addendum language and a one-line billing summary in the doc we’ll route to procurement.

Thanks,
Tom

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Tom Bell <tom.bell@sparrow.ai>, Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@sparrow.ai>, procurement@sparrow.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot planning — surge needs next week

Tom / Sarah — sending the short addendum language below (paste-ready) and a clarified billing summary. Also attached the editable SOW draft: Sparrow_SOW_draft.docx.

Addendum (1 paragraph, insert to Pilot SOW):
"Redwood Inference will provide a time-boxed Surge Booster for the period of YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD consisting of reserved inference capacity as described in PoC_Accelerator_Proposal_v1.pdf. Billing for the Surge Booster will be invoiced as a flat daily rental for the reserved capacity plus overage metering if utilization exceeds the reserved threshold. All other terms of the existing Pilot Statement of Work remain in force."

Billing summary (example for SparrowAI):
- Reserved surge block: 4x A100-equivalent vCPU instances provisioned for 7 days. Flat rental: $2,400/day = $16,800 for the week.
- Overage metering: $0.015 per token generated above reserved bucket.
- Conversion incentive: If SparrowAI signs a 3-month Reserved Commitment within 30 days of the Surge Booster end date, Redwood will apply a conversion credit of 20% of the Surge Booster invoice against the first month’s invoice.

Provisioning SLA: We can provision reserved capacity within 6 hours of signed addendum, or hold a provisional allocation for 24 hours while procurement completes approvals.

Marcus and Priya — can you confirm you’re comfortable with the 6-hour SLA and the 20% conversion credit? If yes I’ll send DocuSign.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot planning — surge needs next week

+1 from me. 6-hour provisioning SLA is operationally reasonable for a one-week reserved block provided we flag capacity in the dedicated pool; 20% conversion credit is acceptable as a short-term incentive for a 3-month commit. Priya, please prepare the DocuSign package and the invoice template (credit line clearly labeled) and loop Legal for a quick review of the single-paragraph addendum.

Vanessa — once DocuSign is ready, send to procurement@sparrow.ai and cc me. I’ll monitor.

Marcus
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
